title: Particle Flow Network — an idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Graph build
scenes.purpose: Data Build (motion-030): reveal the stable authored nodes in place, then their curved rails, then node-owned labels.
visuals: Stationary #0B0F17 surround with sparse #2A3242 dotted field and edge vignette
10 fixed nodes appear in place by opacity and in-place scale (0.00-0.64 s staggered)
9 cubic Bezier rails draw by stroke-dashoffset after nodes (0.20-0.97 s)
Title AN IDEA BECOMES A CONNECTED SYSTEM and subtitle fade in
assets: index.html (SVG back/front layers, Canvas 2D particle layer)

beats.development: Nodes INTAKE, EXCHANGE, OUTCOME, queue and six satellites appear at fixed positions; rails begin drawing; labels reveal after their owning node from 0.36 s.
captions: AN IDEA BECOMES A CONNECTED SYSTEM
PARTICLE FLOW NETWORK · AUTHORED, ILLUSTRATIVE STATES

scenes.title: Activation and first transfer
scenes.purpose: Source activation then transfer: the idea hub lights up and its particle stream travels to the core exchange.
visuals: INTAKE halo and core accent rise idle grey to active amber (0.45-0.95 s); meta IDEA · IDLE -> IDEA · ACTIVE at 0.60 s
Two satellites feed INTAKE with sparse idle streams (head 0.45-0.85 s); the fault satellite's dashed rail carries no particles
Stream head travels INTAKE -> EXCHANGE (0.75-1.30 s) with density ramping 35% -> 100%
Arrival at 1.30 s: EXCHANGE pulses once, halo/ring/core turn active, counter LINKS 00/06 steps to 03/06

beats.development: Activation: INTAKE halo and state accent rise; satellites begin feeding it.
Transfer: seeded particles stream along the INTAKE -> EXCHANGE curve, narrowing at both rims.
Arrival: particles converge into EXCHANGE, which pulses once; LINKS readout steps 01 -> 03 (illustrative).

scenes.title: Second transfer and arrival
scenes.purpose: One transfer at a time: EXCHANGE passes the flow to OUTCOME while the first stream settles.
visuals: Stream head EXCHANGE -> OUTCOME (1.45-1.95 s); INTAKE -> EXCHANGE density eases to 20% idle
Arrival at 1.95 s: OUTCOME pulses once, ring waiting -> active, outer ring appears, meta SYSTEM · WAITING -> SYSTEM · LINKED, LINKS steps to 06/06

beats.development: Transfer: second stream travels from EXCHANGE to OUTCOME; first stream thins.
Arrival: OUTCOME pulses once and its label updates to SYSTEM · LINKED; counter reaches 06/06 (illustrative).

scenes.title: Settle and overview
scenes.purpose: Settle to idle density and hold the complete connected system readable.
visuals: OUTCOME distributes sparse streams to its two satellites (head 2.00-2.35 s)
Main stream density returns to ~24% idle by 2.60 s; halos ease to sustained levels
Queue node stays WAITING with no flow; FAULT satellite stays dashed and stalled
Legend ACTIVE / IDLE / WAITING / FAULT pairs each state with text

beats.development: Settle: densities and halos return to idle levels; outcome cluster receives sparse flow.
Overview: whole graph held readable; only sparse idle particles continue along authored edges.

findings: Brisk 3 s study: build 0.45 s, two sequential transfers of ~0.5 s each, single pulses on arrival, no simultaneous pulses or flashing.
All labels are fully legible from 0.60 s; state text swaps are instantaneous, not blinking.
justifiedHolds: 2.60-3.00 s overview hold so the connected system and final readouts can be read.

notes: Nodes (fixed): intake(330,300,r22,idea,idle->active), exchange(640,390,r44,core,idle->active), outcome(930,230,r24,system,waiting->active), queue(1000,540,r20,queue,waiting), spark-a(200,200), spark-b(180,380), spark-c(300,470,fault), out-a(1060,150), out-b(1080,300), queue-a(1110,620).

Edges (cubic Bezier source->destination): intake->exchange [352,302 440,292 540,330 600,372]; exchange->outcome [676,366 735,315 830,252 904,238]; exchange->queue [682,404 780,438 890,502 978,532] (no flow); spark-a->intake; spark-b->intake; spark-c->intake (fault, no flow); outcome->out-a; outcome->out-b; queue->queue-a (no flow).
All counts, states and the LINKS readout are authored and illustrative, not measured or live telemetry.
